description: Implementation of an HTTP server class handling connections, requests, WebSocket communication, and buffer management within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: HttpServer
classes.description: Implements an HTTP server handling connections, requests, WebSocket upgrades, and response sending.

classes.name: HttpServer::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for handling server events such as new connections, requests, WebSocket requests, and connection closures.

classes.name: HttpConnection
classes.description: Represents a client connection, managing socket, buffers, and WebSocket state.

classes.name: HttpServerRequestInfo
classes.description: Contains parsed HTTP request data including method, path, headers, and body.

classes.name: HttpServerResponseInfo
classes.description: Represents HTTP response data including status code, headers, and body.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Handles WebSocket protocol communication over a connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::AcceptWebSocket
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket upgrade request on a specified connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SendOverWebSocket
methods.description: Sends data over an established WebSocket connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SendRaw
methods.description: Sends raw data over a connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SendResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send
methods.description: Constructs and sends an HTTP response with status, data, and headers.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send200
methods.description: Sends a 200 OK response with data.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send404
methods.description: Sends a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send500
methods.description: Sends a 500 Internal Server Error response with a message.

methods.name: HttpServer::Close
methods.description: Closes a connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: HttpServer::GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the server's local address.

methods.name: HttpServer::GetLocalInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the interface address if listening on INADDR_ANY (platform-specific).

methods.name: HttpServer::SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for a connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for a connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::DoAcceptLoop
methods.description: Begins accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: HttpServer::OnAcceptCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of an accept operation.

methods.name: HttpServer::HandleAcceptResult
methods.description: Processes the result of an accept attempt.

methods.name: HttpServer::DoReadLoop
methods.description: Reads data from a connection in a loop.

methods.name: HttpServer::OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.

methods.name: HttpServer::HandleReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a read operation, parsing requests or WebSocket frames.

methods.name: HttpServer::DoWriteLoop
methods.description: Writes data to a connection in a loop.

methods.name: HttpServer::OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a write operation.

methods.name: HttpServer::HandleWriteResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a write operation.

methods.name: HttpServer::ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses HTTP headers from raw data into request info.

methods.name: HttpServer::FindConnection
methods.description: Finds a connection object by its ID.

methods.name: HttpServer::HasClosedConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection has been closed during callback processing.
